title: Inverse Design of Quantum Control Sequences with Fourier Neural Operators
summary: Quantum optimal control is a key tool for steering quantum dynamics, but its computational cost grows rapidly with the Hilbert space dimension. Here, we introduce a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO)-based framework for learning high dimensional molecular quantum dynamics and accelerating the inverse design of control protocols. Given an initial molecular population distribution, laser frequency, and polarization, the FNO predicts molecular-motional population dynamics up to $10^7$ times faster than GPU-accelerated numerical propagation with CUDA-Q Dynamics.
